method: Bounded keyless GET of exactly the H50-trimmed wave-B queue: H41-planned monthly klines+funding archives for ARK (38 admissible months, 76 files) and ASTR (45 admissible months, 90 files), 166 files total. Each response is hashed and its content checked with stdlib zipfile/csv (single csv member, documented header, non-empty, monotone timestamps). The 18 dropped pre-listing months, wave A (7 assets) and ALPHA are never fetched. No panel, no outcomes.
non_claims: No candidate promoted; no confirmatory or economic claim.
Missing archive files are never fabricated; they remain absent.
Wave A (7 assets, 644 files), ALPHA and the 18 dropped pre-listing months are not acquired; those remain governed by their own decisions.
Does not re-probe the date-gated 2026-11 cutoff month.
Does not alter any frozen DISP-001/002/003 artifact, config, ledger or forward block, and does not unlock H1/H6/H7/H10.
verdict_rule: WAVEB_SCOPE_MISMATCH if the derived wave-B set differs from the pinned H50 166-file scope (ARK 76 / ASTR 90) or a pinned input digest fails; WAVEB_ACQUISITION_INCOMPLETE if any expected file lacks HTTP 200, a sha256, or content_ok; else WAVEB_ACQUISITION_COMPLETE.
